name: 10B Needs Tree
blurb: Categories of human need for the 10B model — combining Maslow's hierarchy, Max-Neef's fundamental human needs, the UN Sustainable Development Goals, and the structural categories of the CIA World Factbook. Each category groups country-level indicators into a satisfaction score with provenance, propagating into a country-level rollup model and a cross-country category rollup. The tree is the supervisory schema for the embedding model that captures the human needs of a population.
mechanism: Schema-only model. Defines the 15 categories, three tiers, theoretical lineage, and the indicator slices each (country × category) model is expected to populate. All other 10B models depend on this schema.

components.name: Needs schema
components.role: Holds the canonical category definitions, frameworks, and indicators.
